extensions.tonalRampProvenance: Existing synthesized OKLCH preview ramps retained as non-normative metadata, not authored design tokens; out-of-sRGB steps may be gamut-mapped by the renderer. White is achromatic. Native system colors are environment-dependent and have no fixed authored ramp.

body.purpose: Paragraphs; legends share its size without an authored weight.

title.purpose: Identity and numbered estimate tiles, not page display headings.

label.purpose: Labels and field text share size and weight; fields explicitly inherit their surrounding font family.

button-label.purpose: Shared action button text; source bold resolves to 700.

shadows.name: action-rest
shadows.purpose: Shared button at rest; removed on active and disabled states.

shadows.name: estimate-pressed
shadows.purpose: Structural selection stroke, not ambient elevation.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Button default and hover transition; disabled during active state.

motion.name: button-loading
motion.purpose: Optional loading pseudo-element rotates to 360deg; source supplies no spinner stroke.

focus.purpose: Shared buttons, estimate buttons, and fields; also applies to keyboard focus.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Shared session and voting action; native fill and border are not local tokens.
components.css: .ds-button { display: block; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; padding: 18px 44px; max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; line-height: 18px; transition: all 0.2s; user-select: none; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); } .ds-button:hover { transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-button:focus, .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { transition: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: default; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Associated session label and font-inheriting field with responsive stacking and shared focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; min-width: 0; gap: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-label { display: flex; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 12px 12px 0; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; font-family: inherit; border: 1px solid black; border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; width: 600px; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 1199px) { .ds-input { width: 100%; margin: 0; } } @media (min-width: 1200px) { .ds-field { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; } }

components.name: Story Textarea
components.description: Multiline story entry; full container width and source minimum height.
components.css: .ds-story-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; min-width: 0; gap: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-story-label { display: flex; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 12px 12px 0; } .ds-textarea { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; font-family: inherit; border: 1px solid black; border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; width: 100%; min-height: 300px; margin-bottom: 24px; resize: vertical; } .ds-textarea:focus, .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 1200px) { .ds-story-field { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; } }

components.name: Identity Tile
components.description: Outlined product identity shared by setup and estimation surfaces.
components.css: .ds-identity { border: 2px solid lightblue; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; width: 100px; height: 100px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; user-select: none; }

components.name: Selected Estimate Tile
components.description: Native pressed estimate button with Mint border, bold text, inset selection stroke, and shared focus outline.
components.css: .ds-estimate-selected { border: 1px solid lightgreen; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; user-select: none; background: white; color: black; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: content-box; } .ds-estimate-selected:focus, .ds-estimate-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-estimate-selected[aria-pressed='true'] { font-weight: 700; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px black; } .ds-estimate-selected:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Estimate Tile
components.description: Unselected native estimate button with Sky border; no authored hover change.
components.css: .ds-estimate { border: 1px solid lightblue; border-radius: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; user-select: none; background: white; color: black; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-sizing: content-box; } .ds-estimate:focus, .ds-estimate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-estimate:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Worksheet Panel
components.description: Full-width native fieldset grouping with responsive padding and minimum height.
components.css: .ds-panel { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-panel > legend { max-width: 100%; } .ds-legend { font-size: 18px; margin-left: 12px; } .ds-paragraph { font-size: 18px; } @media (min-width: 720px) { .ds-panel { min-height: 500px; padding: 24px; } }

components.name: Home Navigation Action
components.description: Single native anchor using shared action styling and explicit CSS system colors.
components.css: .ds-nav-button { display: block; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; padding: 18px 44px; max-width: 100%; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; line-height: 18px; transition: all 0.2s; user-select: none; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); color: ButtonText; background: ButtonFace; border: 2px outset ButtonFace; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-button:hover { transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-nav-button:focus, .ds-nav-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid black; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-button:active { transition: none; box-shadow: none; }

narrative.overview:
Plainspoken and structured. Fields, outlined groups, and numbered estimate tiles organize the work without an ornamental layer.

Border-defined panels, lightly lifted actions. The worksheet's character comes from explicit labels, simple grouping, and compact corner rounding; no visual anti-references are established.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered estimate tiles with a selected-state outline.

rules.name: The Lightly Lifted Action Rule
rules.body: Use the observed button shadow for action depth, not as an invented panel-elevation scale.

dos: **Do** keep the component philosophy plainspoken and structured.
**Do** use Sky Outline for identity framing and Mint Selection for selected estimate framing.
**Do** preserve the distinction between authored component styling and browser/library defaults.
**Do** retain the shared Black focus outline and native button, link, label, fieldset, and form semantics.
**Do** use the authored responsive containers and grids rather than restoring fixed panel dimensions.
donts: **Don't** infer a button-fill or surface palette from native browser appearance.
**Don't** invent visual anti-references or hover color changes absent from the source.
**Don't** substitute ambient elevation for the pressed estimate's inset selection stroke.
